people.name: Benaiah
people.line: A Levite musician during the transfer of the ark.

people.name: Jahaziel
people.line: Levite priest who played the trumpet regularly.

translations.web: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.
translations.bsb: and the priests Benaiah and Jahaziel blew the trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God.
translations.kjv: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.
